meta.notes: frames.* are normalised to 0..1 by their own 98th percentile (level-like series linear in dB); width/balance are natural units (0..1 and -1..1). Sections, key and tempo are estimates.

tempo.note: a guess from onset autocorrelation; score ~0.1+ suggests a steady pulse, near 0 means none

key.note: Krumhansl-Schmuckler estimate over the whole recording — a statistical guess; check `alternative` when r values are close

chroma.note: index 0=C..11=B, one 12-vector per second centred at i+0.5 s, each summing to 1
